articleTitle: Why Postpartum Hair Loss Peaks at 3–5 Months (and What Actually Helps)
imageHeadline: Postpartum Hair Loss Peaks at 3–5 Months
imageSubtext: It's telogen effluvium—temporary, hormonal, and right on schedule.
pinTitle: Why Postpartum Hair Loss Happens at 3–5 Months (and What Actually Helps)
pinDescription: Losing clumps of hair after having a baby isn't a deficiency—it's telogen effluvium, triggered by the estrogen drop after delivery. Learn why it peaks around 3–5 months postpartum, what the research says about supplements, and how to protect your hair while it recovers.

items.label: Hair shifts into shedding phase all at once
